verdict.rationale: First-party docs say the agents return cited responses and cited reports, and that every conclusion is auditable down to the specific literature passage or code that produced it, which matches per-claim verification against sources. The evidence is entirely vendor marketing and docs, with little detail on how citations are attached and shown. Missing for 10: documentation of the per-claim inline citation format and how source passages are surfaced, and independent or hands-on corroboration that citation coverage is complete and accurate.

support.subject: As a researcher, I can see citations for every substantive claim so I can verify it against the underlying source

citations.quote: Every conclusion is fully auditable. You can trace any finding back to the specific code or literature passage that produced it.
Every conclusion is fully auditable, so you can trace any finding back to its original code or scientific source.
You can ask it a complex scientific question and get a high-accuracy, cited response
